about.title: About
about.intro: Hawk Prix Immo provides an indicative, non-binding estimate based on open data and a statistical model.
about.modelBody: The estimate uses an XGBoost model trained on DVF+ sales (Cerema), enriched with ADEME energy performance (DPE) data. Inputs include living area, outbuildings (cellars and parking spaces or garages), location, energy class, and year built.
about.amenitiesBody: These amenities are not in the DVF+ model. When checked, an indicative uplift is added to the predicted price, then the result is always capped at the top of the MAPE range — it never leaves that uncertainty band.
about.amenitiesApartment: Apartment: balcony / terrace ≈ +9%, garden ≈ +20%, shared condo pool ≈ +6.5%.
about.amenitiesHouse: House: garden ≈ +11.5%, pool ≈ +18%. Balcony / terrace is not applied (often already priced into the garden).
about.metricsIntro: Metrics measured on a chronological hold-out set (most recent sales, not used for training).
about.metricsR2Hint: Share of price variation explained by the model. A higher percentage means the model better explains observed prices.
about.metricsMaeHint: Mean absolute error in euros: average gap between predicted and actual prices on the test set.
about.metricsMapeHint: Mean absolute percentage error. It is also used to build the indicative range around the estimated price.
about.metricsNote: These figures describe average past error on a test set, not a guarantee for any single estimate.
about.geocodeBody: Your address is geocoded via the French national address base (Géoplateforme BAN). The match score reflects how closely your input matches the address used for the estimate.
about.agencyFeesDisclaimer: The main price shown excludes agency fees. DVF sale values only include agency fees when they are paid by the seller.
about.agencyFeesBuyerShareOutro: , agency fees are paid by the buyer in approximately 90% of cases.
about.faiBody: The price including agency fees (FAI) adds agency fees to the net price: either an adjustable percentage (4% by default) or a fixed amount in euros. The fee amount is the difference between the FAI price and the net price.
